cases.study_information: Predict the IV terminal half-life, in days, of clone_107, clone_202 and clone_203 from their sequences, human IL-23 binding and functional results, and the visible reference-antibody PK anchor. Full heavy-chain sequences include the actual Fc engineering; sequence2 is VL. A single 50 mg/kg IV dose was studied in male cynomolgus monkeys with serum follow-up through day 91. SPR dissociation was below the reported measurement bound; do not invent a finite KD.

study_id: WO2025170982A2 Example 7: single 50 mg/kg dose in male cynomolgus monkeys, serum follow-up through day 91. Route-specific beta-elimination half-life. The SC clearance column is apparent clearance (CL/F), not independently measured IV clearance. In-vitro values are matched human IL-23 experiments; relative IC50 uses reference_1=1. These are finite-cohort experimental estimates.
dependence_note: Shared experimental family; count in original-family sensitivity aggregation, not as independent biological replication.
title: Predicting engineered IL-23 antibody persistence in cynomolgus monkeys
